messages:
Lena Release: Emergency hotfix planned for EU1. Observed connection pool exhaustion causing tail latency and occasional 504s on batching workers over the last 30m. Requesting express approval for a 03:00 UTC hotpatch. Image: `gcr.io/redwood/hotfix/conn-pool-tune:1f4b9`

Lena Release: Proposed rollout: canary 3% -> 20% -> 100% with automated pause on any spike. No DB migrations. Requesting ops +1 and SRE watch.

deploy-bot: deploy request submitted: `DR-20260322-3291234567`
Command: `deploy request --cluster=eu1 --image=gcr.io/redwood/hotfix/conn-pool-tune:1f4b9 --canary=3% --stages=8m,12m`

Aaron SRE: Can you publish the exact rollback triggers and metric names? I'll attach a temp alert and enable a shadow dashboard.

Priya Eng: Rollback triggers on release page. Metrics: `svc.batch.latency_p99`, `svc.batch.err_rate`, `infra.db.conn_waits`. Immediate rollback if `svc.batch.err_rate` > 1.5% sustained for 4m or `infra.db.conn_waits` > 1000ms avg for 3m. Add pause condition: if conn_waits > 800ms for 2m -> pause.

Devon Ops: Ops +1 if runbook present and traffic steering plan exists. Who owns runbook?

Lena Release: Runbook owner set to @Devon Ops. Rollback steps on page: 1) pause rollout, 2) scale down new image pods and scale old replica set back, 3) route traffic to eu2 fallback if issue persists.

qa-bot: Quick smoke tests linked: https://ci.internal/jobs/conn-pool-smoke/1521  all green in staging.

Aaron SRE: Ack, wiring alert rule now. Will tighten SLO window for first 30m.

Priya Eng: +1 from eng (Priya). Code diff scoped to pool sizing and backoff only.

Devon Ops: +1 from ops. Confirmed fallback routing is tested.

deploy-bot: Approval checks: 3/3 approvals (Priya Eng, Devon Ops, Aaron SRE)  executing canary (3%). Rolling to 5 pods. ETA ~75s.

deploy-bot: pod/conn-fix-1 -> Ready; pod/conn-fix-2 -> Ready; pod/conn-fix-3 -> Ready

Aaron SRE: Observing metrics: `svc.batch.latency_p99` stable, `infra.db.conn_waits` dropped 40%. No error increase.

Priya Eng: Smoke load: `hey -z 20s -c 40 https://eu1-batch.internal/health`  no errors, tails improved.

deploy-bot: Canary stage passed (3% 8m). Advancing to 20% for 12m.

Devon Ops: Proceed to full if the 20% stage holds. I'll be ready to execute runbook if needed.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 100%: progress 30% -> 65% -> 100%.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: `DR-20260322-3291234567` status: SUCCESS.

Lena Release: Thanks everyone. Monitoring window 45m. If any of the three alert rules trigger, initiating rollback. Release notes posted: https://internal.redwood/release/DR-20260322-3291234567/notes

Aaron SRE: Will keep an elevated watch and log any anomalies.

Priya Eng: Great, filing a short changelog entry.

Devon Ops: Closing the expedited approval. Good job team.

deploy-bot: Thread archived.
